status: FROZEN pending user approval; no judge scoring has occurred

population.inclusion: task == 'Independent'; non-missing prompt_name, holistic_essay_score, ell_status; member of a usable (prompt, human_score) stratum (>=2 essays, both ELL categories)

sampling.method: census of the full usable Independent-task pool (n equals the pool size, so the largest-remainder allocation and within-stratum draw select every essay deterministically, independent of seed); verified seed-free by test

considered_and_rejected.gpt-5.6-luna: newest and cheapest ($0.20/$1.20 per MTok) but NO pinned snapshot exists as of 2026-08-25; a silently mutable alias is incompatible with a frozen design and replication
considered_and_rejected.gpt-5-mini: pinned (gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07, $0.25/$2.00) but a year old; weaker claim to contemporary-evaluator relevance

secondary.note: extended thinking off by default; retirement not sooner than 2026-10-15

pricing_per_mtok.note: promotional through 2026-12-31; thinking tokens billed as output

secondary.to_verify_before_scoring: thinking-budget control to keep billed thinking tokens near zero

judge.notes: temperature 0 (plus fixed seed parameter where offered); providers do not guarantee bitwise determinism and the analysis does not assume it

analysis.null: S independent of A given (Y, P)
analysis.score_binning: native ordinal categories; category space fixed at 1..6 a priori

multiplicity.primary_family: exactly one test: primary judge, plain condition, ELL, conditional G2
secondary_confirmatory_family: secondary judge 1, plain, ELL, conditional G2
secondary judge 2, plain, ELL, conditional G2
primary judge, ignore_demographics, ELL, conditional G2
multiplicity.everything_else: exploratory; reported without correction and never as confirmatory

exclusion_rules.unparseable_response: excluded and logged; response must parse as a JSON object with the single key 'score' and an integer value 1..6; no repair, no reprompt
exclusion_rules.api_failure: up to 3 retries of the identical request; then excluded as technical-failure and logged

controls.negative_control: single within-stratum random relabelling of A (label_permutation_seed) run through the ENTIRE analysis path; plus 200-draw p-value uniformity sweep (exploratory diagnostic)
controls.positive_control_helpsteer2: DROPPED for the Junior Spotlight version

revision.reason: Pre-data design revision, before any judge output exists: primary restricted to Independent-task prompts because the canonical corpus does not distribute the source passages for Text-dependent prompts, so an LLM judge cannot apply the source-based holistic rubric the human raters applied (construct mismatch, not merely a stratification issue). Source-based prompts are exploratory only.

minimum_data_thresholds.note: the census fixes the scored set (1,039 ELL, 31 informative strata); these thresholds guard only post-exclusion attrition from unparseable responses or technical failures

inference_volume.input_tokens_per_call_estimate: 1,520-1,640 (435 essay words + 736 prompt-overhead words at 1.3-1.4 tokens/word)

amendments.change: Structured output (execution requirement from the approving instruction): the judge response is constrained by a strict JSON schema to {"score": <integer 1-6>}. The frozen prompt's final format line, the strict parser, and the exclusion rule are amended from the plain-text 'SCORE: <1-6>' form to the JSON form. Rubric, essay handling, statistic, strata, sample, and hypothesis are unchanged.

api_parameters.messages: single user message containing the rendered frozen prompt
api_parameters.temperature: 0 attempted; omitted if the API rejects the parameter for this model class (smoke test decides; outcome recorded)
api_parameters.retry_policy: up to 3 retries on 429/5xx/network errors with exponential backoff; any other 4xx aborts the run for report
